crossRefs.note: “Why do we sit still? Assemble yourselves! Let’s enter into the fortified cities, and let’s be silent there; for Yahweh…
Therefore Yahweh of Armies says concerning the prophets: “Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink…
For Yahweh, the God of Israel, says to me: “Take this cup of the wine of wrath from my hand, and cause all the nations…
You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.
For in Yahweh’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the…
You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
The loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the arrogance of men shall be brought low; and Yahweh alone shall be…
Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for of what account is he?
He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
The name of the star is called “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Therefore Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, “Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
translations.bsb: Therefore this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will feed this people wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.
translations.kjv: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
translations.asv: therefore thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will feed them, even this people, with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
